name: ListItem
description: A row with leading, title, description and trailing parts. Set href or interactive and the title becomes a link or a button that covers the row, so the whole row is one target. Rows go in a List, whose variant frames them (bordered) or rules them (divided).

livewire.name: list-item
capabilities: Container: list (variant plain, bordered or divided); list-item children render as li
navigate adds wire:navigate to an internal href
The 2.x item, value, sub-value, avatar and link attributes still fill the row, deprecated

react.name: ListItem
capabilities: Container: List (variant plain, bordered or divided); ListItem children render as li

vue.name: ListItem
capabilities: Container: List (variant plain, bordered or divided); ListItem children render as li

props.name: title
props.description: The row's main text. The title slot overrides it.

props.name: description
props.description: Secondary text under the title. The description slot overrides it.

props.name: href
props.description: Makes the title a link that covers the row. Only relative, http, https, mailto, tel and sms URLs are used.

props.name: interactive
props.description: Without href, makes the title a button that covers the row, for a click handler on the row. Emitted as data-interactive; href sets it too.

props.name: selected
props.description: Marks the current or chosen row. Emitted as data-selected.
props.a11y: The row's link or button gets aria-current="true".

props.name: disabled
props.description: Dims the row; its link or button is disabled. Emitted as data-disabled.
props.a11y: A disabled link loses its href and gets aria-disabled.

props.name: leadingIcon
props.description: Icon name in the leading part, resolved through the icon registry. The leading slot overrides it, for an avatar or a thumbnail.

props.name: trailing
props.description: Short text at the end, such as a time or an amount. The trailing slot overrides it, for a badge or an action.

props.name: navigate
props.description: Adds wire:navigate to an internal href, so Livewire swaps the page in without a full reload.

props.name: classes
props.description: Extra classes per part, such as { title: '…' }.

parts.name: root
parts.description: The row: an li inside a List, a div on its own.

parts.name: leading
parts.description: An icon, avatar or thumbnail at the start.

parts.name: title
parts.description: The main text; a link or a button covering the row when it's interactive.

parts.name: trailing
parts.description: Short content at the end, above the row's link so its controls stay clickable.

slots.name: leading
slots.description: Leading content, such as an avatar or a thumbnail.

slots.name: trailing
slots.description: Trailing content, such as a badge or an icon button. Keep it short, and keep to one primary action per row.

keyboard.action: Moves to the row's link or button, then to any controls in trailing.
Follows the row's link or activates its button.

requirements: Interactive rows are links (href) or buttons (interactive), never a clickable li; the control covers the row.
Selection sets aria-current="true" on the row's link or button.
Rows in a List are li elements of a ul.
The focus ring is drawn inside the row, so rows in a list don't overlap it.
Title text keeps 4.5:1; the description is --apui-text-muted.
Disabled rows set aria-disabled, use --apui-text-disabled, and their link or button is disabled.
